local_review.finding_body: The modified ActiveMQClientTest teardown called unbounded BrokerService.waitUntilStopped() and caught and logged stop failures, violating the bounded-test requirement in FS-test-contract.1.6 and allowing cleanup failure to be hidden. This was contribution-local and repairable under FS-contribution-contract.5.1.
local_review.finding_title: ActiveMQ test teardown waits indefinitely and suppresses shutdown failures
local_review.fix_note: Changed the 6.2.7 teardown to propagate BrokerService.stop() failures, removed the unbounded wait, asserted that the broker stopped, and regenerated the 6.2.7 statistics. The Forge finalizer then completed successfully and made no further publishable change.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the full contribution diff, the successor-range issue context, local gate evidence, and resolved statistics. The shared-suite split preserves 6.2.7/6.2.8 separately from 6.3.x, changes stay within the permitted artifact files, dynamic-access coverage rises from 18.8406% to 100%, tests exercise ActiveMQ public API paths without Native Image skips or legacy metadata, and the exact Forge finalizer passed all three test lanes, metadata validation, style checks, generated-test checks, and statistics generation without further publishable changes.
